fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy glob on the first enemy it meets, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.6 seconds and having a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Waited-For Lunge
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 40 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Unhurried
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Does It
fusions.desc: When your health is full, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
